scope: Original 35 development case identities; fresh image experiment separate from skill iteration campaign and rollout.
changed: Waveform PNG only: full-cluster median/10-90% band, plus shared pair y-limits in phase2. Both arms use identical deterministic member sampling, source waveforms and corrected numeric observations.
unchanged: Same exact state, skill, system, numeric observations, image order/count, model parameters, and original non-waveform PNGs. Legacy phase1 stays three-view; expert phase1 stays four-view; phase2 stays three-view. Neither original images nor audit cases are overwritten.
state_gate: Expert states must match recorded pre-action assigns hash; historical states must match NPZ and MAT hashes. Stop on any mismatch. No reserved/quarantined data.
scoring: Same action match and three harm-constraint definitions as replay_scoring_v1.json; raw/summary reported separately by target, phase and image layout; exact paired changes and original rationales. No repeat consistency or significance claim. New images require fresh calls in both arms; no comparison to old paid responses as if inputs were equal.
decision: Report descriptive paired differences only; no automatic deployment or winner adoption. The combined summary/axis intervention is not separately attributable to its components.
stop: Whole-round conservative estimate must fit $25 cap; per-request reserve; zero retries; stop on provider error, refusal, truncation or parse failure. No implicit rollout budget.
disclaimer: Tests incremental value of these plot changes, NOT whether VLM/images are necessary versus numeric-only and NOT complete closed-loop performance.
